subject: ShardBank pilot: request for 'golden hour' P1 carveout and escalation path
messages:
From: Elias Morales <elias.morales@shardbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: golden-hour P1 coverage for migration week

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week — good conversation. We’re planning a phased migration of our core payments flows to Redwood starting the first week of September. Given the business-critical nature of this cutover, our ops and risk teams are asking for a temporary support guarantee during the launch window: a "golden hour" for P1s (acknowledge within 15m, triage/initiate remediation within 60m) for the first three weeks of the migration.

We understand this is outside the standard SLOs you publish. We are prepared to add a short-term uplift to cover the incremental on-call cost. Before we put legal on it, can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) provide a runbook-backed escalation path (including a named engineering escalation), 2) offer a dedicated PagerDuty escalation policy and a Slack emergency channel, and 3) cap the SLA credit if SLA isn't met?

Attached is a short spreadsheet with our expected traffic windows and the specific P1/P2 definitions we’ll use.

If possible, we’d like a short confirmation by Thursday so we can finalize change freezes and roster planning.

Thanks,
Elias
Elias Morales
Head of IT Operations, ShardBank
Attachment: ShardBank_Support_Requirements.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elias Morales <elias.morales@shardbank.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: golden-hour P1 coverage for migration week

Elias —

Appreciate the clear ask and the attachment. We can support a time-boxed pilot with stronger operational guarantees, provided we lock in a few constraints:

- Pilot scope: 3 weeks (start: 2026-09-07) covering the EU production cluster and the pre-scheduled high-traffic cutover windows you shared.
- SLA terms for the pilot: P1 acknowledge within 15 minutes, initial triage/owner assigned within 60 minutes, P2 acknowledgement within 2 hours. These are for incidents that meet the P1/P2 definitions in your spreadsheet.
- Escalation path: dedicated PagerDuty policy (we’ll provision PD escalation rule), dedicated Slack channel (#shardbank-urgent) with a 24/7 alert bridge, and named engineering escalation (primary: Marcus Lin, backup: Priya Natarajan).
- Limits: the SLA credit for the pilot will be capped (we propose $5,000 total cap) and only applies to missed P1 triage windows during the pilot.
- Cost: a one-time pilot operational uplift of $7,500 plus usage — covers dedicated on-call shadowing and runbook tuning.

I’m looping in Priya and Marcus to confirm on-call bandwidth and Marcus to own the runbook/engineer escalation. We’ll draft an SLA appendix and runbook for signature (DocuSign) and provide a short weekly health report during the pilot.

If that sounds acceptable, we’ll send the DocuSign and a proposed runbook PDF by end of day.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference

Elias —

Thanks for the patience. We can confirm the pilot as discussed. Key agreed items below (summary and next steps):

- Pilot window: 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-27 (3 weeks).
- SLA commitments for pilot: P1 acknowledge <= 15 minutes, P1 initial triage/owner assigned <= 60 minutes; P2 acknowledge <= 2 hours. Applies to incidents that match the definitions in your spreadsheet.
- Operational channels: dedicated PagerDuty policy (PD Policy ID: PD-4521), Slack channel #shardbank-urgent (we’ll invite your on-call rotation), and an always-on alert bridge during scheduled cutover windows. Marcus Lin will be the named engineering escalation owner; Priya Natarajan is backup.
- Commercials & limits: one-time pilot operational uplift $7,500 (invoice on acceptance), SLA credit capped at $5,000 total for the pilot. Credits apply only for missed P1 triage windows and exclude customer-network or third-party infra failures.
- Governance: DocuSign SLA appendix to be signed before the pilot goes live (link: https://docusign.com/ABC-Runbook-Approve). We’ll provide a weekly health report every Friday and a 30-minute sync with your ops lead after each cutover.

Attached is the runbook we’ll use to onboard the on-call shadow and the PD escalation policy excerpt. Please sign the DocuSign by next Wednesday to lock the start date.

If you’d like, we can also schedule a 20-minute pre-cutover tabletop with your ops and our engineering leads next week.

Best,
Vivek
